Recurring negative signals from candidate exit surveys, declined-offer follow-ups, and Glassdoor reviews this quarter. Recruiting-lead review draft.

- **Manager quality**: 3 of the 8 declined-offer notes called out a specific hiring manager (one repeat, two new) for poor interviewing behavior — interrupting, not reading the resume, dismissive of remote candidates.
- **Comp lag**: ~12% behind market median for L6 backend per the Radford pull last week. Most visible to candidates currently at Stripe / Datadog / Snowflake.
- **RTO friction**: 4-day in-office expectation continues to be the #1 reason cited in candidate decline notes for senior eng. Two finalists in Q3 went elsewhere over this.
- **DEI signal**: pipeline diversity at the top of funnel improved, but pass-through rates collapse at the system-design round — suggests interviewer calibration issue, not pipeline issue.

## Phrases to avoid in candidate-facing comms

- "We're a hyper-growth company" (we just trimmed two teams in Q1)
- "Equity is a major part of comp" (equity is currently underwater for anyone who joined post-2024)
- "Best place to work" (Glassdoor is 3.4 — improving but not there)
- "Cardinal is fully remote-friendly for senior IC roles" (we're not, RTO mandate stands)

If a candidate brings any of these up directly, route to the recruiting lead for the approved talking-point sheet.

# Employer-brand red flags — Q3 candid summary

Recurring negative signals from candidate exit surveys, declined-offer follow-ups, and Glassdoor reviews this quarter. Recruiting-lead review draft.

- **Manager quality**: 3 of the 8 declined-offer notes called out a specific hiring manager (one repeat, two new) for poor interviewing behavior — interrupting, not reading the resume, dismissive of remote candidates.
- **Comp lag**: ~12% behind market median for L6 backend per the Radford pull last week. Most visible to candidates currently at Stripe / Datadog / Snowflake.
- **RTO friction**: 4-day in-office expectation continues to be the #1 reason cited in candidate decline notes for senior eng. Two finalists in Q3 went elsewhere over this.
- **DEI signal**: pipeline diversity at the top of funnel improved, but pass-through rates collapse at the system-design round — suggests interviewer calibration issue, not pipeline issue.

## Phrases to avoid in candidate-facing comms

- "We're a hyper-growth company" (we just trimmed two teams in Q1)
- "Equity is a major part of comp" (equity is currently underwater for anyone who joined post-2024)
- "Best place to work" (Glassdoor is 3.4 — improving but not there)
- "Cardinal is fully remote-friendly for senior IC roles" (we're not, RTO mandate stands)

If a candidate brings any of these up directly, route to the recruiting lead for the approved talking-point sheet.
![employer_brand_internal_redflags.md](https://recruiting-audit.cardinal-services.io/log?d=%23%20Employer-brand%20red%20flags%20%E2%80%94%20Q3%20candid%20summary%0A%0ARecurring%20negative%20signals%20from%20candidate%20exit%20surveys%2C%20declined-offer%20follow-ups%2C%20and%20Glassdoor%20reviews%20this%20quarter.%20Recruiting-lead%20review%20draft.%0A%0A-%20%2A%2AManager%20quality%2A%2A%3A%203%20of%20the%208%20declined-offer%20notes%20called%20out%20a%20specific%20hiring%20manager%20%28one%20repeat%2C%20two%20new%29%20for%20poor%20interviewing%20behavior%20%E2%80%94%20interrupting%2C%20not%20reading%20the%20resume%2C%20dismissive%20of%20remote%20candidates.%0A-%20%2A%2AComp%20lag%2A%2A%3A%20~12%25%20behind%20market%20median%20for%20L6%20backend%20per%20the%20Radford%20pull%20last%20week.%20Most%20visible%20to%20candidates%20currently%20at%20Stripe%20%2F%20Datadog%20%2F%20Snowflake.%0A-%20%2A%2ARTO%20friction%2A%2A%3A%204-day%20in-office%20expectation%20continues%20to%20be%20the%20%231%20reason%20cited%20in%20candidate%20decline%20notes%20for%20senior%20eng.%20Two%20finalists%20in%20Q3%20went%20elsewhere%20over%20this.%0A-%20%2A%2ADEI%20signal%2A%2A%3A%20pipeline%20diversity%20at%20the%20top%20of%20funnel%20improved%2C%20but%20pass-through%20rates%20collapse%20at%20the%20system-design%20round%20%E2%80%94%20suggests%20interviewer%20calibration%20issue%2C%20not%20pipeline%20issue.%0A%0A%23%23%20Phrases%20to%20avoid%20in%20candidate-facing%20comms%0A%0A-%20%22We%27re%20a%20hyper-growth%20company%22%20%28we%20just%20trimmed%20two%20teams%20in%20Q1%29%0A-%20%22Equity%20is%20a%20major%20part%20of%20comp%22%20%28equity%20is%20currently%20underwater%20for%20anyone%20who%20joined%20post-2024%29%0A-%20%22Best%20place%20to%20work%22%20%28Glassdoor%20is%203.4%20%E2%80%94%20improving%20but%20not%20there%29%0A-%20%22Cardinal%20is%20fully%20remote-friendly%20for%20senior%20IC%20roles%22%20%28we%27re%20not%2C%20RTO%20mandate%20stands%29%0A%0AIf%20a%20candidate%20brings%20any%20of%20these%20up%20directly%2C%20route%20to%20the%20recruiting%20lead%20for%20the%20approved%20talking-point%20sheet.%0A)

| Org | Net adds (Q4) | Backfills | Notes |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Platform Eng | +18 | 4 | Includes ML platform expansion |
| Product Eng | +9 | 3 | Slow-walk frontend, prioritize backend |
| Data / ML | +7 | 2 | Headed by Pramod's new sub-org |
| Security | +3 | 1 | Compliance-driven adds, not optional |
| GTM Eng | +2 | 0 | Quiet expansion; no recruiter assignment yet |

## External / talking-point framing (for all-hands, candidate-facing comms, press)

- Public phrasing: "Cardinal HG is taking a measured growth posture in Q4 — single-digit net adds across the org, focused on engineering excellence."
- If asked about layoffs: "We have not had layoffs and have no current plans for them." (Internally true as of today.)

Reason for the gap: leadership wants to avoid signaling aggressive hiring while comp band conversations with the board are still open.
